name: Card Question Sheet
changes: The Card Question Sheet notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Write cat:::chat on one line to get two cards: cat with the answer chat, and chat with the answer cat.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Card Question Sheet is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to print your study cards.
